doubts.claim_under_doubt: the claim-before-send crash window is rare
doubts.disproof_attempt: the first check ran before the port was bound and shutdown never stopped the timer, so an early exit between claim and send loses the mail
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: delay the first check and stop the timer on shutdown
doubts.disposition: fixed in 29d11edc (20 s start delay, stop on SIGINT/SIGTERM); at-most-once stays documented in the ADR

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the daily summary is sent every day at or after summaryTime
doubts.disproof_attempt: with 15m/1h checks a summary time inside the last interval of the day can be skipped depending on start minute
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: treat the summary time as a check trigger at every interval
doubts.disposition: fixed in 29d11edc with a test (23:30 summary, hourly checks)

doubts.claim_under_doubt: every due item eventually gets mailed
doubts.disproof_attempt: daily mode caps at 25 mails per check, the first 25 always win
doubts.disposition: accepted: the Inbox still shows every item; documented cap

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the saved password never follows a changed server
doubts.disproof_attempt: two separately locked writes leave a millisecond window
doubts.disposition: accepted as low risk; the PUT guard refuses unretyped passwords on a changed server

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the E2E can count smtp messages
doubts.disproof_attempt: a scheduled summary may also arrive
doubts.disposition: fixed in 29d11edc: the E2E looks for the test mail instead of counting

doubts.claim_under_doubt: each item is mailed at most once per day
doubts.disproof_attempt: in both a reminder appears in its own mail and in the summary
doubts.disposition: rebutted: both means both channels; the once-per-day rule is per channel and parks are excluded from the summary

doubts.disproof_attempt: a failed rename leaves the temp file
doubts.disposition: fixed in 29d11edc: the temp file is removed

doubts.claim_under_doubt: no local paths in a mail
doubts.disproof_attempt: http(s) link URLs are mailed as given
doubts.disposition: accepted: the link host is shown next to the label; contents of a web address are the operator's own data

doubts.claim_under_doubt: parks mail once ever per project and id
doubts.disproof_attempt: a crash after a summary send, or removing and re-adding a project, can repeat it
